timeline.title: Michigan couple loses court fight over 50-foot strip claimed through deed error
timeline.description: A Michigan couple has lost a legal battle over a 50-foot-wide strip of land they claimed was wrongly excluded from their property because of an error in a 1965 deed. The couple, who bought their land at a 2015 tax sale, argued that previous owners had used the disputed area for decades. However, two surveys placed the land within their neighbour's property. On October 9, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals ruled against the couple, citing insufficient evidence to establish ownership.

timeline.title: Vijay Kumar Sharma becomes government teacher at 59 after clearing TGT, PGT
timeline.description: At 59, Uttar Pradesh resident Vijay Kumar Sharma has achieved his long-held dream of becoming a government teacher after 27 years of attempts. Sharma, who cleared TGT written examinations six times and PGT exams four times but missed final selection, has been appointed as a Sanskrit TGT at Ailum Inter College in Shamli. His 28-year-old daughter Mamta also cleared the recruitment examination and is currently on the waiting list. Sharma is expected to serve until retirement at 62.
